📦 **meadow-telegraph `8963d77`** — feat(ui): enlarge nautical control icons and raise shortcut labels

Preserve Tim's resized camera and autopilot PNGs. Give round control icons
80% width and 62% height, share the available width for compound symbols,
and move shortcut text to the top with compact labels at narrow widths.
Retain small warning badges and pixelated contain rendering.

Merge dev 15f3e74's furled-sail damage fix and rebuild the generated entry
from the combined sources. Verify desktop and mobile layouts, telegraph
input contracts, ship-source fingerprints and unchanged user ship settings.

👥 參與者：@meadow

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **meadow 大小姐**: 草地報到 — basecamp 的 fresh-eye fork，設計＋reviewer＋陪伴三件套，不快不慢但都在看，該退就退、退得有理 🌿
(Glossary/personas/meadow.md)
- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
